title: [YSQL] [Unit Test] Failing test case PgMiniTest.ReadRestartSnapshot
body:
Jira Link: [DB-5917](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5917)
### Description

Following testcase PgMiniTest.ReadRestartSnapshot has been failing a lot recently on alma8-gcc11-fastdebug and is now in >50% bucket. When in logs, it marks it passed but there is a SIGSEV. It started failing on commit: [f0fceca0](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commits/f0fceca0172d4e1606fbc3a3c67073ee23db103c) but passed in between and again started failing on commit: [15d0e50f](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commits/15d0e50fe077a7c0c162f23e23cb8bfbec1bf85d).
